answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 19 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the atlas solution is checked at the river gate and logged, the canyon audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence forfeits the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The fee repeats 25 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
